class.name: InputMapSettingsActions
class.brief_description: The content of the settings file of [InputMapSettingsServer].
class.description: The file form of [InputActions] in the settings file of [InputMapSettingsServer] (JSON, INI, YAML, TOML, XML): one [InputMapSettingsAction] per action, each with its [InputMapSettingsEvent] records. CSV uses [InputMapSettingsEventRows]. [InputMapSettingsServer] converts between [InputActions] and this resource when it saves and loads; games do not need this class.
